method: agy -p / -c (and one interactive session in tmux) with --model gemini-4-neon on the Gemini API key, in a scratch directory /tmp/agy-scratch, 2026-11-19

prompts.plain: What is 17 times 23? Answer with just the number and the phrase zebra-quokka-lantern.
prompts.shell: Run the shell command: ls /tmp/agy-scratch && echo marker-heron-plum . Then report the output.
prompts.edit: Create a file named notes.txt in the current directory containing exactly the line: walrus-saffron-kettle. Then change that line to walrus-saffron-teapot by editing the file.
fail-continue: Run the shell command: cat /nonexistent/agy-missing-file . Report the exit code.
(agy -c) Now run: echo continued-otter-fig . Report what it printed.
interactive: Run: echo live-session-pelican-crumb . Reply with what it printed.
Run exactly this command: seq 1 20000 | sed 's/^/line-/' . Then just tell me the last line it printed, nothing else.
